page_title: STU 2-0 BOC | Stuttgart v Bochum 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
90+4' Tim Oermann (Bochum) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman makes the right call and Bochum will have a corner.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 59000.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Matus Bero (Bochum) attempts to discuss the decision with Benjamin Brand, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
89' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
88' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
87' Here's the change. Moritz Broschinski leaves the pitch and Lukas Daschner (Bochum) comes on as a substitute.
86' Substitution. Jeff Chabot is replaced by Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).
85' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anrie Chase (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Leonidas Stergiou.
84' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
84' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.
83' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Felix Passlack will be replaced by Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum).
79' The substitution is prepared. Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Anthony Losilla.
78' 2 - 0 Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
77' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Enzo Millot.
77' Substitution. Chris Fuhrich did his best and is replaced by Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart).
76' A raking crossfield pass from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
74' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
72' The yellow card goes to Philipp Hofmann (Bochum).

72' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
71' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
69' Bernardo (Bochum) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is behind the touchline and Stuttgart will take a throw-in.
67' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) produces a killer pass onto Josha Vagnoman, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
66' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
65' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
64' Substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dani de Wit (Bochum).
64' Dieter Hecking decides to make a substitution. Gerrit Holtmann will be replaced by Bernardo (Bochum).
63' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Patrick Drewes easily deals with the threat.
62' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
62' Bochum seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
60' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
59' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and signals a foul after Anthony Losilla (Bochum) brought his opponent down.
57' It is time for a substitution. Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is on for Nick Woltemade.
56' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
53' 1 - 0 Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the right post in trademark fashion.
52' Felix Passlack (Bochum) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
51' Felix Passlack (Bochum) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
50' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

50' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Stuttgart.
49' The referee blows his whistle as Anthony Losilla (Bochum) was too aggressive in his challenge.

46' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Stuttgart are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
44' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart will take a throw-in.
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Stuttgart, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

41' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benjamin Brand has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Stuttgart in a dangerous position.
40' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

37' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
37' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
37' An attempted cross from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Stuttgart are going to take it.
35' Alexander Nubel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
33' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
28' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
26' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
26' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Bochum earn a corner.
25' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

25' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
23' Stuttgart showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
20' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball has crossed the sideline. Stuttgart are taking a throw-in.

17' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the set piece. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and crashes against the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
17' It seemed like Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
16' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Stuttgart will take a free kick.
15' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul after Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) hacks down one of his opponents.
14' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
13' Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

10' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart will have a throw-in.
9' A quickly taken corner by Stuttgart.

8' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Stuttgart get a corner.
6' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
4' Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
3' Wonderful movement by Stuttgart. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
2' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) makes a strong challenge and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul.

The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benjamin Brand.
